findings.sentence: Marcella disputed his own scriptural answers for years, not to argue, he said, but to learn what could be said against every answer - and after he left Rome, it was to her house that the clergy brought their disputed questions.

findings.sentence: Years later our own monastery at Bethlehem was burned by fellow Christians, and we wrote briefly of it afterward: 'As for our house, so far as fleshly wealth is concerned, it has been completely destroyed by the onslaughts of the heretics; but by the mercy of Christ it is still filled with spiritual riches. To live on bread is better than to lose the faith.' A pope, hearing of that same attack from the women who reported it to him, wrote of 'the ravages, murders, fires and outrages of all kinds, which they say that the devil has perpetrated' against us.
